name: Smoqued California BBQ
tagline: Slow-smoked ribs, brisket burnt ends, famous 420 Mac, and local California craft drafts
description: Located on North Glassell Street just north of The Circle, Smoqued California BBQ brings artisanal wood-smoked barbecue to historic Old Towne. Smoking their meats low-and-slow over hickory, red oak, and fruitwoods, Smoqued is celebrated for caramelized brisket burnt ends, tender St. Louis ribs, the legendary '420 Mac' (creamy mac & cheese topped with Texas chili, pulled pork, and smoked bacon), and a rotating tap wall of fresh California craft beers.
historicNote: Situated in a restored 1920s Old Towne commercial storefront featuring high timber beams, exposed brick masonry, and the iconic neon pig silhouette sign.

specials.title: Monday Half-Rack St. Louis Rib Night
specials.description: Half-rack of tender, slow-smoked St. Louis cut pork ribs served with two classic sides and honey cornbread for $18.

specials.title: Smoked Meat Tuesday Tacos
specials.description: $4 smoked brisket, pulled pork, and chicken street tacos on fresh corn tortillas with cilantro, pickled onions, and house salsa.

specials.title: Wing & Draft Wednesday
specials.description: $1 smoked jumbo wings tossed in your choice of spicy habanero BBQ or sweet honey glaze, plus $6 local California draft pints.

specials.title: Signature Burnt Ends Power Hour
specials.description: Double-smoked certified Angus brisket burnt ends tossed in sweet BBQ glaze, served over house fries for $14.

specials.title: TGIF 420 Mac & Beer Pairing
specials.description: Order the famous 420 Mac (four cheeses, Texas chili, pulled pork, bacon, and onion strings) and get any craft pint for half price.

specials.title: Pitmaster Weekend Smoke Platter
specials.description: Choice of two slow-smoked meats (brisket, pulled pork, ribs, or jalapeño cheddar sausage) with two large sides and cornbread.

specials.title: Sunday Game Day Tailgate Pack
specials.description: BBQ sliders, smoked wings, and loaded cheese fries with all NFL and college sports on the bar screens.

events.title: Monthly Pitmaster Craft Beer Pairing
events.description: Four-course smoked BBQ tasting flight paired with regional California craft beers and live acoustic country music.
events.location: Smoqued Dining Room (128 N Glassell St)
